simple.meaning: יָנַק (yânaq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to suck ; causatively, to give milk.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 32 times across Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, and 10 more, beginning at Genesis 21:7. Its contexts include birth, family, family line, death.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יָנַק (H3243).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: to suck ; causatively, to give milk
